headline: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure
summary: Ford is launching an AI-powered assistant for its vehicles. It can answer questions about fuel, towing capacity, and tire pressure. The assistant is rolling out to Ford and Lincoln mobile apps first.

headline: Space mirrors could ruin astronomy — and your eyes
summary: Futurists envision space mirrors for continuous solar energy on Earth. Russian scientists experimented with this concept in the '90s. Concerns exist about potential light pollution for astronomy and eye damage.

headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: The music history podcast 'No Dogs in Space' has been on hiatus since July 2024. Its abbreviated third season focused on experimental rock bands like Can. Fans are eagerly awaiting new episodes of the series.

headline: Zuckerberg's yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: A stranded skiff was rescued by the Alaskan cruise ship Wilderness Legacy. Tracking data shows Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was reportedly closer. A passenger on the cruise ship documented the rescue.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day 4K Steelbook Designs Seemingly Revealed, Since Removed by Amazon
summary: Amazon briefly revealed cover art for Spider-Man: Brand New Day's 4K Steelbook. The designs were quickly removed from listings. Fans liked the Steelbook art but criticized the Collector's Edition cover.

headline: Why a Warhammer 40,000 Book Just Sold for $3,150 on eBay
summary: A rare Warhammer 40,000 book was sold on eBay for an astonishing $3,150. The high price left many fans surprised. This sale highlights the significant value of collectible gaming merchandise.

headline: Harry Potter Fan Protest Diverts Power Line Planned to 'Go Straight Through' Dobby's Grave
summary: Harry Potter fans successfully campaigned to alter plans for a new power line. The original route would have passed directly through Dobby's grave site. Their efforts led to the power line's diversion.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Will Be 'Brutal' for Steve Rogers, Chris Evans Says, as Fans Fear for the Fate of His Child
summary: Chris Evans teased that 'Avengers: Doomsday' will be "brutal" for Steve Rogers. Fans are expressing concern over the potential fate of Captain America's child. The comments hint at intense storyline developments for the character.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A single small boat carried a record 230 people across the Channel. This breaks the previous record of 165 people set in July. The incident highlights the growing intensity of Channel crossings.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: Travelodge staff provided a domestic abuser with a key to his victim's hotel room. The attacker then kicked the door off its hinges to gain entry. The victim shared her terrifying experience with the BBC.

headline: Thames Water gave finance boss a £1m signing-on fee
summary: Thames Water awarded its new finance boss, Steve Buck, a £1 million signing-on fee. This significant payment was part of his recruitment package. The troubled utility company is facing financial difficulties.

headline: Ban on 'subscription traps' brought forward by three months
summary: The UK government has fast-tracked the ban on 'subscription traps' by three months. This measure is part of the prime minister's efforts to reduce living costs. The announcement was made during a series of public addresses.
